data_eligibility_rule: relaxed_data_eligibility_v1; identical real 2303 bars and strictly-prior synchronized 4-peer close proxy for both arms; no fill/imputation
single_change: B waits for exactly one consecutive completed 5-minute bar after the original V2-B setup; that close must remain strictly above the saved original breakout line; entry is at the open of the immediately following actual 5-minute bar

confirmation.setup_signal: original V2-B technical conditions and prior-only market regime pass on completed setup bar
confirmation.confirm_bar: same session, exactly 300 seconds after setup bar; completed close > saved setup BREAKOUT_HIGH
confirmation.fill_bar: same session, exactly 300 seconds after confirmation bar; actual next tradable bar open
confirmation.missing_or_nonconsecutive_bar: EXCLUDE_NO_FILL; never substitute a later bar or cross sessions
confirmation.false_breakout_definition: Among regime-passing original V2-B setup candidates with three later observed session closes, a false breakout is any of those next three session closes at or below the saved setup breakout line. This is post-hoc descriptive only and never feeds signals.

eligibility.target_policy: retain unique valid real target bars; no synthetic bars; mask affected indicator windows; missing signal/confirmation/fill bars cannot be presumed

peer_proxy.reference: strictly prior synchronized peer close dates

execution.B_entry: one full confirmation bar close, then next actual 5-minute bar open

exit: frozen V2-B prior 30-bar low and Risk V1 stop/holding rules; identical for both arms
